slots.title: The crypto industry has found new ways to grow. Making money from them is another story
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Coinbase, Robinhood and Circle are expanding into stablecoins, payments and prediction markets, but their latest earnings show how hard it is to escape crypto's boom-and-bust cycles.

slots.title: Thailand moves to block Bitget as crypto exchange's local acquisition faces uncertainty
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Thailand’s SEC filed a criminal complaint against Bitget’s operator, alleging it ran an unlicensed crypto exchange for Thai users from 2022 to 2025.

slots.title: U.S. added 165,000 jobs in October, blowing past 65,000 estimate
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: The unemployment rate unexpectedly fell to 4.1%. The strong showing surely puts a December rate hike in play, but next week's inflation numbers and the fate of the stock market could prove more important.

slots.title: Ramp data shows AI spending stalling just as Anthropic nears its IPO
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: AI usage keeps climbing, but spending has stalled. Price cuts and smarter cost controls among the biggest spenders could challenge investor assumptions about AI hypergrowth.

slots.title: Bitcoin steadies after AI-led selloff as eyes turn to latest U.S. jobs figures
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Bitcoin bounced from around $75,200 after Thursday’s AI-led selloff, which drove more than $1 billion in liquidations, as traders await the U.S. jobs report.
slots.reason: A major development affecting both AI and blockchain
